messages:
maria: kicking off onboarding + perf check for whirlpool/snowcap-7b-v2. weights uploaded to gs://redwood-model-artifacts/whirlpool/snowcap-7b/v2/weights.tar.lz4
ajay: path looks good. did you run manifest verification (sha256 + file list)?
maria: manifest verified. quick tokenization smoke failed though 12: HF tokenizer export has duplicate special token id 50256 mapped to two different strings, saw double entries in tokenizer.json.gz
jerome: duplicate ID 50256 will break KV index math and can inflate token counts. that explains tail latency spikes under batching.
maria: exactly. batch=8 seq=512 p95 was ~135ms on first run. after inspecting tokenizer dump I found: 
```
50255: ""
50256: "<|endoftext|>"
50256: "<|eot_dup|>"
```
ajay: yep that's bad. simplest is remap the duplicate to an unused id (e.g. 51000) and rebuild tokenizer + vocab. remember to update any code that verifies vocab size.
kevin: also check loader does the embedding matrix vs vocab header check. we had silent resizing once that caused misaligned embeddings. add CI check.
maria: remapped duplicate -> 51000, rebuilt tokenizer.json.gz and pushed to s3://redwood-tokenizers/whirlpool/snowcap/tokenizer.json.gz. running unit tokenization tests now.
ci-bot: [pipeline] upload started for s3://redwood-tokenizers/whirlpool/snowcap/tokenizer.json.gz (job #4821)
j erome: once upload completes, re-run rbench. use this command: `rbench run --model=whirlpool-snowcap-7b-v2 --profile=latency,throughput --batch-sizes=1,2,4,8,16 --seq-lens=128,256,512 --concurrency=12 --warmup=300`
maria: queued rbench on dedicated pool d-pool-6, capturing kernel traces. quick smoke after remap: batch=1 p50/p95: 9ms / 28ms; batch=8 p50/p95: 65ms / 102ms (was 135ms pre-fix); throughput (seq=256, batch=8): ~290 req/s
olivia: improvement, but p95 still high. attach the kernel trace for the 102ms tail. want to see if it's batching delay vs fallback kernel.
maria: trace shows intermittent kernel fallback to a slower fused-unfused path on node r-gn8-03 around 512 token boundary; heuristics picked unpacked attention for some seqs because of skewed length distribution from earlier tokenization variance.
ajay: two action items: 1) add a pre-tokenize normalization step that collapses duplicate special-token sequences; 2) update kernel selection to prefer fused-attn up to seq<=600 when memory headroom allows.
kevin: +1. add a regression in eng-ml CI: tokenizer-fuzz that randomizes special-token duplication and verifies stable token counts and embedding alignment.
maria: will open PR with remap, loader guard, and CI test. for immediate deploy plan: canary rollout policy: 5% traffic -> 20m observe -> 50% -> full. auto-fallback to whirlpool-snowcap-7b-v1 if p95 > 200ms. also bump max_cache_items from 262144 -> 350000 for canary because remap temporarily bumped tokenized lengths and caused earlier eviction.
ci-bot: [rbench] job 7829 submitted, logs: https://rbench.internal/jobs/7829
jerome: please monitor p95 and tokenization error rate. if tokenization errors > 0.1% or p95 > 180ms, abort canary and roll back.
maria: canary started on d-pool-6 shard-2. I'll post 30min perf snapshots and attach rbench traces. ping me for any alerts. thanks team :rocket:
